Katherine is bugged by a message left on her answering machine: a prisoner against whom she testified has been released and wants to talk to her.

George learns that Nicky's school's football team is recruiting players from outside the district.

When Nicky (Corky Nemac) has trouble writing to a girl (Ami Dolenz) he has a crush on, Webster comes through: excerpts from Katherine's old love letters.

Jordan and Tyreke find themselves escorting two young coeds to the Homecoming Dance --- until girlfriends Tia and Tamera decide to show up at the last minute!

Jordan confronts his fears when Tamera and friends convince him that love is a two-way street.

description:

Ray is frustrated that his political campaign is not allowing him the time to get to the heart of the issues with his constituents. His campaign manager has been driving Ray hard, and the results are starting to make an impact.

description:

Frank and Dee announce they want to have a child of their own, surprising Moesha and causing Miles to run away.

title: Moesha
description:

Hakeem gets a girlfriend, making both Kim and (surprisingly) Moesha jealous.  They conspire to break up the romance, resulting in a heart broken Hakeem.

title: Moesha
description:

Moesha and Kim discover some boys at school have a list of the girls with various physical attributes including the “biggest booty” and Moesha is astounded to find her name on the list.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E2 — Credit Card
Moesha has her own car, so Frank gives her a credit card for emergencies only.  When she goes out with her new boyfriend, Q,  he convinces her to let him drive her car.

title: Moesha
description:

Moesha has befriended a Latina student, Teresa.

When Mary and Sandra go to court to settle a dispute over song royalties, Sandra's ammunition is veteran 'barrister' John Houseman, while Mary's ace in the hole is a 'Supreme' expert witness, singer Mary Wilson.

S3 E11 — Mistaken Identity
Mayhem and murder plague 227 when a mysterious man with a knife rents an apartment in Mary's building.

S3 E12 — Country Cousins
When Mary and Lester go to the reading of his uncle's will, they are both surprised to learn they have distant cousins whom they've never met, and even more confused when they discover they are a different color.

S3 E13 — Shall We Dance
When Lester's old high school sweetheart comes to the neighborhood in search of a new home, Mary fears that she'll try to move in on more than just her turf.
